description: Centre-Atlantique : Canalisations TMD - GRTgaz - Scénarios générateur SUP1 sur interconnections et compressions (ponctuel) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Access to data is restricted to authorised persons. This dataset contains the reference position of the SUP1 generating scenarios on interconnections and compression, i.e. to the natural gas transmission lines of the GRTgaz carrier. The data shall be provided by the GRTgaz carrier. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Central Atlantic: TMD pipelines — GRTgaz — SUP1 generator scenarios on interconnections and compressions (one-off)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
